findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: avenity_get_competitor_landscape, avenity_score_business, avenity_list_services, avenity_book_consultation, avenity_request_callback · Private data: avenity_get_case_studies, avenity_request_callback · Public sink: avenity_get_opportunity_report, avenity_request_callback · Destructive: avenity_list_services, avenity_book_consultation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: avenity_get_competitor_landscape, avenity_score_business, avenity_list_services, avenity_book_consultation, avenity_request_callback · Private data: avenity_get_case_studies, avenity_request_callback · Public sink: avenity_get_opportunity_report, avenity_request_callback · Destructive: avenity_list_services, avenity_book_consultation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "avenity_book_consultation" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
